guidance.heading: Outlook
section: Genpact's updated outlook for the full year 2026 is as follows:
•Net revenue growth of at least 7% year-over-year on an as reported basis, or 6.8% on a constant currency basis.2
◦In Advanced Technology Solutions, we expect revenue to grow at least 25% year-over-year.
◦In Core Business Services, we expect growth to continue year-over-year.
•Gross margin outlook increased to approximately 36.9%, up approximately 90 basis points year-over-year.
•Adjusted income from operations margin4 of approximately 17.7%, up approximately 25 basis points year-over-year.
•Adjusted diluted earnings per share5 growth increased to at least 13% year-over-year.
